user_story: As a clinic manager I want every user to sign in with a role so that staff only see what their job needs
acceptance_criteria: Given a nurse, when she opens /admin/analytics, then she receives 403

user_story: As a patient I want my booked slot to be mine alone so that I never arrive to find a clash
acceptance_criteria: Given 20 simultaneous requests for one slot, then exactly one appointment is created

user_story: As a patient I want to see real-time availability and book online so that I don't have to phone
acceptance_criteria: Given a doctor and day, when I pick a free time, then the slot is booked and disappears from availability

user_story: As a patient I want to reschedule or cancel so that the slot is freed for someone else
acceptance_criteria: Given a booked appointment, when I cancel, then the slot is bookable again and reminders are withdrawn

user_story: As a doctor I want a single secure record per patient so that history, allergies and diagnoses are in one place
acceptance_criteria: Given an EHR entry, then the database stores ciphertext and each read is audited

user_story: As a doctor I want a dashboard of today's schedule, waiting room and open tasks so that I can run clinic from one screen
acceptance_criteria: Given checked-in patients, then the dashboard lists them in queue order with estimated waits

user_story: As a nurse I want to record lab results against the patient so that doctors see them immediately
acceptance_criteria: Given a CRITICAL result, then the result appears on the record and the doctor gets an SMS alert

user_story: As a doctor I want to send e-prescriptions with an allergy check so that unsafe medication is stopped
acceptance_criteria: Given a penicillin allergy, when I prescribe Penicillin V, then it is blocked unless I record an override

user_story: As a receptionist I want the queue to reorder for emergencies and late arrivals so that care is fair and safe
acceptance_criteria: Given an emergency check-in, then that patient is first; late arrivals go behind on-time patients

user_story: As a patient I want SMS and email reminders so that I don't miss appointments
acceptance_criteria: Given a booking, then a confirmation is sent now and a reminder 24 h before, never twice

user_story: As a doctor I want to assign tasks such as vitals checks to nurses so that preparation happens before the consult
acceptance_criteria: Given a task, only the assignee can move it TODO to IN_PROGRESS to DONE

user_story: As a clinic manager I want wait times and doctor utilisation on a dashboard so that I can spot bottlenecks
acceptance_criteria: Given visits, then average wait and utilisation per doctor are displayed

user_story: As a clinic manager I want a forecast of peak hours so that I can roster enough staff
acceptance_criteria: Given six weeks of history, then an hourly forecast and staff recommendation are shown

user_story: As a patient I want loyalty points and health-check offers so that regular care is rewarded
acceptance_criteria: Given five completed visits, then I reach 50 points and qualify for a discounted health check

user_story: As a patient I want my data protected if a backup leaks so that my privacy is preserved
acceptance_criteria: Given a raw database dump, then no clinical text is readable

user_story: As the team we want CI on every pull request so that defects are caught before merge
acceptance_criteria: Given a PR, then flake8 and pytest run and coverage below 80% fails the build

user_story: As a user with low vision I want an accessible interface so that I can use the system independently
acceptance_criteria: Given keyboard-only navigation, then every control has a visible focus state; WCAG 2.1 AA contrast

user_story: As a clinic I want pages to load quickly at peak so that reception is not delayed
acceptance_criteria: Given 100 concurrent users, then 95% of requests complete in under 2 s (load test with Locust)

user_story: As a clinic I want the system available in clinic hours so that care is not interrupted
acceptance_criteria: 99.5% monthly availability; Multi-AZ database; tested restore from backup

user_story: As the clinic owner I want compliance with the Australian Privacy Principles so that we meet legal duties
acceptance_criteria: Privacy impact assessment completed; data held in Australian region; audit log retained
